title: The Ledger of Valparaíso
author: Oscar Thackeray
blurb: Sebastian Brightwater, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
